structure: Part 9, Transporter. Read in full: transport-and-arrival.fit.spec.js (the 'transporter details', 'germinal transporter details' and 'add a transporter' describes, lines 120-373) and snagging.fit.spec.js (toTransporter helper and the 'transporter details' describe, S26 and S27), and mined all 12 traces the part names, each opened with its full action list, the pages snapshotted with eval and the data calls read from the network log: (1) transporter details › select a transporter from the list (core); (2) transporter details › a chosen transporter is shown on its own, and can be changed or removed (variant); (3) transporter details › transporter is optional to proceed (variant); (4) transporter details › the legacy transport-details path redirects (variant); (5) germinal transporter details › guidance not shown for germinal products (variant); (6) snagging S26 search box (variant, includes a no-JavaScript render); (7) snagging S27 where the add a transporter link sits (layout); (8) add a transporter › choose a transporter type (core + validation); (9) private transporter: name and postcode, an address from the list, then contact details (core + validation); (10) private transporter: enter address manually (validation); (11) private transporter: cancel (variant); (12) commercial transporter: authorisation number first, then a Northern Ireland postcode or manual entry (core + validation). Every trace reaches /transporter after arrival details with means of transport Air, except the germinal trace, which goes straight to /transporter after create-notification?category=germinal-products. Page inventory, in journey order: transporter-details (/design-release-2.1/transporter; three states: the list to select from, the selected transporter on its own, and the list again with ?change=1; plus a success banner after adding); transport-details-redirect (/transport-details, a 302 to /transporter); choose-transporter-type (/transporter/add); add-private-transporter (/transporter/add/private, three states on one URL: name and postcode, 'Select an address' results, and the full details-and-contact step reached from a chosen address or 'Enter address manually'); add-commercial-transporter (/transporter/add/commercial, four states: authorisation number, postcode (?step=transporter back link), 'Select an address' results (?step=postcode back link), and the manual details-and-contact step fixed to Northern Ireland). After either add flow the user lands on /transporter with the new transporter selected. Conditional: the DAERA/APHA authorisation guidance shows only for live animals; the notification status bar (Draft and reference) shows on /transporter and on the commercial pages but not on the choose-type or private pages. Next page after /transporter is /upload-documents. The network log shows only the prototype's own form posts (localhost:3010) and browser-sync noise (localhost:3011); the address lookup happens server side, so no outbound postcode call is visible.

A postcode outside Northern Ireland is never entered in the commercial flow, so whether it is refused is not shown.

Entering a commercial address manually shows the same fields as the private details step (name, address lines, town or city, county, postcode, country, then 'Enter contact details' with email and phone), but Country is a disabled select fixed to Northern Ireland.

claims.statement: The add-transporter pages are built from GOV.UK radios, warning text, notification banner, input, select, label, hint, error summary and button components, but their layout and field widths use custom app-transporter-add-* classes, and 'Enter address manually' and 'Change postcode' are submit buttons styled as links. Standard govuk-input--width-* modifiers, a govuk-caption-l and a govuk-heading-l would replace the custom ones.
claims.quote: app-transporter-add-page__caption app-transporter-add-page__heading app-transporter-add-private-fields__input--full app-transporter-add-private-fields__input--one-half app-transporter-add-private-fields__input--two-thirds ... BUTTON|submit|action||manual|||govuk-link app-govuk-body-link|Enter address manually
claims.note: The choose-type radios also carry app-reason-for-import-radios, a class borrowed from the reason for import page.

claims.statement: The add-a-transporter flow is walked only for live animals; whether germinal products get the same flow, including the commercial authorisation banner, is not shown.
Typing a search that matches no transporter is never tried, so any 'no results' message is not shown.
